body:
Context from #3586 / PR #4174, which bounds the blast radius of this without fixing it.

That PR adds `timeout-minutes: 20` to the `shadcn-check` job, so a black-holed connection now costs 20 minutes of a runner instead of the 360-minute default. The `fetchUrl` gap this issue names is exactly why that line was needed and why it was sized the way it was: with no socket timeout in the script, nothing else bounds the hang.

Two measurements taken while sizing it, in case they are useful here:

- Run `31374857502` (2026-08-10) completed all 46 serial requests in **~1.7 s** (09:30:22.71 to 09:30:24.03), i.e. ~37 ms per request, with `Registry: 0 cached, 46 fetched` and 0 errors. So the healthy path has enormous headroom — a per-request timeout of even 10 s would be ~270x the observed per-request cost and would never fire in normal operation.
- All 30 runs in the workflow's API history completed in 19-49 s wall clock, so there is no historical run that a per-request timeout in that range would have disturbed.

The job timeout is a backstop, not a substitute: it turns a hang into a 20-minute red job rather than into a fast, well-attributed error naming the component that hung, and it does nothing for anyone running `pnpm shadcn:check` locally. This issue stays the real fix.

**Adjudicated (within delegation gates — build-script tooling, no contract surface):** per-request timeout **10s**, **no retry**, fail fast with an error that names the URL that hung. Basis: the 2026-08-10 measurements on this card — healthy path is ~37ms/request (10s ≈ 270× headroom), all 30 historical runs complete in 19–49s wall clock, so the timeout never fires in normal operation; a black-holed connection does not resolve in seconds, so a retry only doubles the worst-case hang budget while the existing error path already degrades gracefully (`--check` marks the error, `--update` refuses to write). The 20-minute job backstop from PR #4174 stays as-is — this is the real fix it was standing in for. Maintainer may veto/adjust the value on this card; the dispatch proceeds meanwhile.

Scope: `scripts/shadcn-sync.js` `fetchUrl` (`req.setTimeout(10_000, …destroy…)` shape), all 46 serial requests covered; error text names the component/URL; verify both `--check` and `--update` degrade exactly as the card describes. PR will be `Fixes #4031`.
